messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - spike in 5xx for hosted inference EU (eu-west-1) following deploy of inference-gateway:2026.03.17. Paging on-call.
paige_prod: customers reporting failures, graphs show 5xx concentrated in eu-west, taking requests that hit KMS decrypts.
mike_r: digging into logs - seeing repeated `AccessDeniedException: User does not have kms:Decrypt` referencing key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789:key/abcd-rotated. Looks like the env var was switched to a rotated key id.
devon_h: canary nodes hit the same error. Canary traffic was 5% but the env flip propagated; the canary health check didn't catch KMS permission issues.
jess_ops: tagging @sre_oncall — do we have an immediate kill-switch or rollback path?
sre_oncall: taking pager. First step: pause traffic to the new variant and flip feature flag to route to previous backend. Also coordinate an env revert if possible.
paige_prod: customer impact: two mid-market customers saw failed calls, internal error budget shows eu-west 5xx up ~12%. No data loss observed so far.
mike_r: quick mitigation options: (1) revert BACKEND_KMS_KEY to previous id, (2) update IAM role to grant kms:Decrypt on rotated key. Reverting env is fastest.
devon_h: we have a deployctl canary kill endpoint. I can run `./deployctl set-env inference-gateway eu-west-1 BACKEND_KMS_KEY=abcd-prev --canary=false` and push to canary, then promote.
jess_ops: initiating revert now. Pinging @paige_prod to monitor customer errors.
incident-bot: job started by jess_ops (job id dj-20260317-789).
sre_oncall: while deploy runs, add a temporary fallback so existing sessions can use cached plaintext. Patch: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-gateway KMS_FALLBACK=true` — do it on canary first.
mike_r: applied KMS_FALLBACK on canary nodes. That dropped errors on those pods immediately.
jess_ops: env revert completed on canary; monitoring metrics.
paige_prod: canary metrics: 5xx rate returned to baseline, latency normal. Proceeding to promote.
incident-bot: promotion completed — traffic shifted back to previous variant, errors decreasing.
sre_oncall: full rollback scheduled for EU region and disabling global rollout of the new key. Creating follow-ups: [1] confirm service account/IAM needs kms:Decrypt on rotated key or update key policy, [2] add preflight in pipeline to validate KMS permissions, [3] extend canary checks to include KMS decrypt test.
mike_r: will open PR to add `kms-permission-check` and coordinate with eng-security for key policy changes.
devon_h: timeline for postmortem: alert at 10:13, mitigation (env flip) at 10:21, rollback complete at 10:28. Impact limited to eu-west and two customers.
jess_ops: handing off to daytime oncall @paige_prod for customer comms and postmortem.
paige_prod: acknowledged. Drafting incident summary and a customer notification. Severity P1, mitigation steps: revert env var, enable KMS_FALLBACK, rollback release, pipeline guard PR.
incident-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED (mitigated) — follow-up tasks created. :white_check_mark:
